messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "keep all pens, vials, needles, and syringes out of reach of children"
set: ["keep all pens, vials, needles, and syringes out of reach of children", "keep out of reach of children and pets", "keep out of the reach of children", "keep this and all medicines out of the reach of children", "store securely out of sight and reach of children", "dispose of used pens, needles, and syringes in an approved sharps container", "keep out of light", "store at room temperature away from moisture and heat and out of reach of children", "keep on hand at all times", "keep with you at all times", "rule out other causes of hair thinning", "place needles and syringes in puncture-proof sharps container", "keep all follow-up visits with healthcare provider", "swallow all of the mixture right away", "drink all of the mixture right away", "provide list of all medicines to healthcare provider"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
